snippet.title: Monopoly: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains | Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Gameplay Overview Trailer for Monopoly: Star Wars™ Heroes vs. Villains.

Discover how Monopoly evolves with a bold Star Wars twist, featuring team‑based play, character abilities, and dynamic board moments that can change the game with every roll.

Pre‑order now to unlock two unique in‑game dice skins at launch on June 11.

#MonopolyStarWars
